messages:
Evelyn (People Ops): Heads-up  new manager starts Mon 04/20. I'm drafting a condensed "Manager Orientation Pack" (Day 0 email, Day 1 agenda, single-page 30/60/90 + 7-day tactical list). Need quick checks on what we can't forget.

Maya (HR): Must include payroll ID checklist, benefits enrollment link + deadline, manager handbook PDF, and probation review timeline. Also please flag the manager training slot in week 2.

Ravi (IT): I'll stage laptop + SSO image. Most friction: SCIM group sync and repo admin perms. Plan: pre-create IT ticket and include a "Start IT triage" link in the Day 0 email. If access missing >2h on Day 1, new manager should click that link and ping @Ravi.

Theo (Eng Manager): Include a short 7-day manager checklist: set recurring 1:1s with directs, review last 3 sprint retros and open actions, inspect oncall rota & runbook owners, meet product partner. Also add who signs the 30/60/90 (I prefer the skip-level).

Leah (Hiring Manager): Please add a 1-paragraph "What success looks like" for the role to the 30/60/90 header. Makes alignment with skip-level easier. Also include immediate contacts (payroll, legal, infra).

Evelyn (People Ops): Draft Day 0 email (send 48h before):
```
Subject: Welcome to Redwood  quick pre-start items
Hi {{name}},
Two quick asks before Day 1:
- Upload photo ID (payroll)
- Confirm laptop delivery window
- Click SSO invite and complete auth
Links: manager handbook, benefits, onboarding packet, "Start IT triage".
See you at 09:00 on Day 1 for a short kickoff.
```

Maya (HR): Add: "Bring original ID or company letter for payroll verification" and attach a short benefits FAQ. I'll assign a benefits buddy.

Ravi (IT): I'll add a brief troubleshooting snippet for common git/ssh issues and post the IT ticket link once pre-provisioning is done. Sample: ```ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa || eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa```

Evelyn (People Ops): Draft Day 1 agenda (compact):
- 09:00 Welcome + paperwork (HR)
- 09:45 Access verification (IT)
- 10:30 Team & cross-func intros (Hiring mgr + Eng mgr)
- 12:00 Lunch with buddy
- 13:30 30/60/90 sketch + skip-level expectations (15m)
- 14:00 Tools walkthrough (OKRs, dashboards, incident playbooks)
- 16:00 EOD sync with People Ops (confirm outstanding blocks)

Theo (Eng Manager): For the single-page 30/60/90, keep columns: Objective | Success metric | Key milestones | Blockers | Sign-off. One-line cells recommended.

Leah (Hiring Manager): I'll DM the role success blurb. Also, can People Ops host a 30-min office hour in week 1 on writing good 30/60/90s? I can co-host.

Evelyn (People Ops): Yes, scheduling a Thu office hour in Week 1. Escape hatch: if essential access missing >2h, click "Start IT triage" link -> auto-join Zoom -> ping @Ravi. People Ops will join if escalation needed.

Onboarding Bot: Reminders created: send Day 0 email 48h before start, send Day 1 agenda 24h before, schedule Week1 check-in on Day 7.

Maya (HR): Confirming I'll assign buddy and ensure payroll & benefits enrollment are done by Day 3 to avoid missed deadlines.

Ravi (IT): Pre-provisioning ticket created (#IT-ONB-1718). ETA for full access: typically 24h if ticket queued today. Will post the ticket link in the packet when ready.

Evelyn (People Ops): Action owners: Ravi = access & triage link, Maya = payroll & benefits buddy, Theo = team intros + ops quickref, Leah = role blurb & skip-level signoff, Evelyn = calendar templates + final packet. I'll post the live packet here by EOD Friday. Drop any short 30/60/90 examples or micro-checklist items here. :thumbsup:
